title: Marketing Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities: Visit schools and meet school management to generate business. Develop relationships with schools and secure uniform orders. Identify new business opportunities and expand the customer base. Manage and guide the sales team to achieve targets. Follow up with schools regarding quotations, orders, and payments. Monitor sales performance and prepare regular reports. Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to business growth.
